items.item: The orders table starts in the first viewport; no KPI cards, hero or greeting above it
items.evidence: section#kpis renders 4 KPI cards (Orders this month, Awaiting fulfilment, Awaiting payment, Ready to ship) above the table; table header sits at y=437 (audit firstTableTop) though rows do show in the first viewport.

items.item: Page header has a plural title and exactly one primary action (create order)
items.evidence: h1 'Sales orders'; header has 'Export CSV' (outline) and 'New order' (#newOrder, solid indigo); audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: 2–3 filters are visible; applied filters show as removable chips with a clear-all control
items.evidence: Three filters visible (#fPay, #fCh, #fRange) plus search and sort, and a 'Clear filters' button, but no applied-filter chips are rendered anywhere in the markup or script.

items.item: Status tabs or saved views show counts
items.evidence: renderTabs(): role=tab buttons All 64, Draft 0, Confirmed 4, Processing 2, Shipped 13, Delivered 36, Cancelled 9.

items.item: Bulk selection has a header checkbox with an indeterminate state and a bulk bar showing the selected count
items.evidence: #all checkbox; render() sets $('all').indeterminate = selOnPage > 0 && selOnPage < ids.length; #bulk bar shows 'N selected'.

items.item: When results span pages, the user can select all matching results, not just the visible page
items.evidence: #all handler only selects the current page slice (filtered(false).slice(page window)); aria-label 'Select all orders on this page'; no 'select all N matching' affordance.

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures and locale currency formatting; dates are absolute
items.evidence: Total td 'text-right tabnum' with Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency'}); dates via Intl.DateTimeFormat 'Nov 4, 2026'; audit numericCells misaligned=0, nonTabular=0.

items.item: Filtering to zero results shows a no-results state with a way to clear filters, distinct from the first-use empty state
items.evidence: #empty shows 'No orders match your filters' with #emptyReset 'Clear filters' button, but there is no separate first-use empty state (no data / create first order) implemented, so the distinction does not exist.

items.item: Row actions show at most two visible controls; icon-only controls have accessible names
items.evidence: Each row has a single 'View' button (plus the order-id link and checkbox with aria-label 'Select order X'); the only icon-only control, #dClose, has aria-label 'Close order details'.

items.item: A destructive bulk action (cancel orders) asks for confirmation naming the count and the consequence
items.evidence: window.confirm('Cancel ' + n + ' selected order(s)? This cannot be undone.') for data-bulk=cancel; names count, consequence is generic (irreversibility only, does not mention auto-refund of Paid orders) and uses a native confirm.

tells: kpi-icon-tiles (KPI tile row above the table; no icons, but the template stat-card strip)
tracked-uppercase-labels (thead 'uppercase tracking-wide'; sidebar section labels 'uppercase tracking-wider'; audit uppercase-tracking x2)
navy-sidebar-indigo-accent (bg-slate-900 sidebar, indigo-500 logo tile and count badge, indigo-600 primary)
oversized-radius (rounded-xl 12px on KPI cards and table card; audit radius-scale error)
rainbow-status (status pills in slate/blue/amber/violet/emerald/red for six statuses)
notes: Competent functional list (working filters, tabs with counts, drawer, indeterminate header checkbox, bulk bar) but misses the brief on KPI cards above the table, applied-filter chips, select-all-matching, and a first-use empty state. Rows are two-line (audit table-row-two-line 15/15, row height 61px). Audit score 68 with contrast errors in the sidebar, and drop shadows on cards. Cancel confirm uses a native window.confirm.
